hinweise: Dual cut: Cut search is skipped: the pool per card is calibrated only for the cards and the model of the reference boot (RTX5090,RTX3080,RTX3080) -- seed by GEMM rate

The run says that, not the planner.

hw.text: No measured hardware profile for these cards yet: memory sizes and bandwidth are catalog (datasheet) values, rates are borrowed from the nearest measured card. Every figure below is an estimate; the first boot on this hardware is the measurement.

calc: cards: 3 cards = 72.0 GiB of VRAM in total (RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB + RTX 3090 24 GB 24.0 GiB)
weights: weights 20906 + draft 1478 MiB x (2N-1)/N = x 5/3 (D's tensor-parallel shard and P's pipeline stage are resident at once) = 36.4 GiB
KV: ONE request at the ceiling must fit the shared pool: 262144 tokens x 34816 B (fp8, 16 attention layers) = 8.5 GiB (never seats x tokens)
state: 6 seats x 74.8 MiB recurrent state (48 linear layers) = 0.4 GiB
per card outside the pool: 3 x 4784 MiB (graphs, activations, reserves; derived from the dry run) = 14.0 GiB
needed 59.4 GiB against 72.0 GiB available: margin 12.6 GiB
